# CLI Surface

Package: `tenex`

Version: `0.0.4`

Binary: `tenex -> ./dist/cli.js`

## Commands

| Command | Purpose | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tenex new [name]` | Create a new TanStack Start and Convex project. | `src/commands/new.ts` |
| `tenex init [name]` | Alias for `tenex new`. | `src/commands/new.ts` |
| `tenex add <addon>` | Enable a supported add-on in an existing Tenex project. | `src/commands/add.ts` |
| `tenex doctor` | Validate Tenex config and env requirements. | `src/commands/doctor.ts` |
| `tenex dev` | Run the generated app and Convex dev process. | `src/commands/dev.ts` |
| `tenex deploy` | Write deploy handoff output and run deploy validation. | `src/commands/deploy.ts` |
